review_method: single-person item-by-item verification of region, OCR, transcription, tree and M-labels; no cross-review

heldout_split.method: deterministic, group-aware, book-stratified 20% holdout; duplicate-tree groups kept whole; test drawn only from usable_for_eval

sampling_note: records come from an error-enriched candidate pool; any proportion describes this review subset only and must not be extrapolated to overall accuracy.
distribution_note: source PDFs and page images are not distributed; use source_file, pdf_page_1based and source_pdf_sha256 to re-check the underlying pages.
